assessment.nobel_worthiness: A strong, unmistakable voice. The Blinding (Orbitor) trilogy and Solenoid build a visionary, densely patterned prose cosmos from memory, body, dream and metaphysical speculation. The formal ambition is high: long, architectonic structures with sustained linguistic density. The work is also a major and distinctive contribution to Romanian-language and European literature, with poetry at its base.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would cover imaginative and metaphysical prose of unusual scale and formal invention, rooted in poetry and in Romanian literary modernism and postmodernism.
assessment.maturity: A long career with consistent quality across poetry, short prose and large novels. The major works are established, and the oeuvre appears to be still developing.
uncertainties: Assessment rests on public knowledge and translations; I have not independently verified the texts and cannot judge the Romanian prose at the level of the original.
Translation quality varies across the large novels and may affect how the density of the prose reads.
The coverage of the poetry in translation is thinner than that of the novels.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: An exceptionally original, uncompromising voice in Chinese-language fiction. Dreamlike, non-causal narratives dismantle conventional psychology and realism. They are consistent over decades and philosophically ambitious, and they are often linked to Kafka, Borges and Chinese tradition in criticism. Novels and stories such as Frontier and Love in the New Millennium show real formal radicalism.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would concern radically experimental, dreamlike fiction that has reshaped the possibilities of narrative in Chinese, together with her critical writing on literature.
assessment.maturity: A sustained oeuvre of several decades with a stable, deepening method. Her international recognition is relatively recent.
uncertainties: Her prose is heavily dependent on translation; I cannot assess the original Chinese style from the translations.
The fiction is deliberately opaque, and the translations cover only part of a large body of work.
The balance between formal uniformity and development across the oeuvre is hard to judge from English-language coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Uncanny, precise French prose in which exclusion, family power and unstable belonging become disturbing narrative situations. Rosie Carpe, Three Strong Women and My Heart Hemmed In are notable novels, and her plays add a second, distinct strand. Her restraint and control of estrangement give the oeuvre a clear identity within contemporary French writing.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would concern fiction and drama that expose social and psychological strangeness with formal control and a singular voice.
assessment.maturity: A substantial body of work since the 1980s, with consistent quality in both novels and plays. The work is well established.
uncertainties: The ambition and scale of the oeuvre are narrower than those of the largest candidates, so her relative standing is debatable.
I have not independently verified texts. The drama is less accessible in translation.
Whether the uncanny method keeps deepening or becomes a repeated mode is a judgment I cannot settle from public knowledge alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed, highly worked French prose. Small Lives (Vies minuscules) and The Eleven (Les Onze) turn obscure lives and art-historical episodes into intense narrative inquiry, with real linguistic achievement. It is an unusually concentrated body of work whose quality rests on style and compression rather than on volume.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would address a rigorous prose art of the biographical fragment, on the relationship of art, power and obscurity.
assessment.maturity: A small, finely made corpus, steady in quality since the 1980s. Its slim volume makes it harder to claim the breadth of the largest oeuvres.
uncertainties: The style is very difficult to render in translation, so the translated reception may understate or distort the achievement.
The relatively small corpus raises the question of breadth and sustained development.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Danube and Microcosms combine travel, essay, scholarship and fiction into a humane and learned image of Central European borderlands, memory and intellectual history. The achievement rests on hybrid form and cultural depth, and it is substantial. Whether the prose itself is as distinctive as the intellectual project is for the committee to weigh.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would cover genre-crossing literary essays and fiction on Europe's borderlands and memory, alongside his work as a Germanist.
assessment.maturity: A long career that is complete and well established, with a central place in Italian and Central European letters. Consideration now would be unrelated to any recent surge of attention.
uncertainties: The balance between scholarly and essayistic work and imaginative literature complicates the claim under the will's idealistic, creative-literature framing.
Translations vary, and I have not independently verified the texts.
His thematic territory has been widely covered in recent decades, which may affect how the committee weighs the case.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large-scale poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise, together with landscape-scale and skywriting interventions, convert collective suffering after the Chilean dictatorship into monumental memorial form. The ambition and formal originality are distinctive, and the poetry has depth of vision. As a poet, he is a legitimate candidate on the same criteria as the novelists.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would concern poetry that joins personal and collective trauma with visionary scale, including works that extend beyond the printed page.
assessment.maturity: A long career since the late 1970s with a coherent, expanding project and strong standing in Spanish-language poetry.
uncertainties: Poetry loses much in translation, and I cannot assess the Spanish at the level of the original.
The non-page works are harder to treat as literature in the sense of the will.
Public-knowledge coverage of the whole oeuvre is partial.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis remade modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a sustained dialogue with the inherited tradition, as in Songs of Mihyar the Damascene. His critical essays on the Arabic poetic heritage and his editorial work have affected the whole field. The influence on Arabic poetry is substantial and long-lasting.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would concern poetic innovation in Arabic and the critical reinterpretation of its tradition.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with established, wide influence. The oeuvre is mature and its major contributions are already settled.
uncertainties: Much of the achievement lies in the Arabic language and prosody, which translations convey only partly.
The essays and cultural criticism are not easy to separate from the poetry in an assessment of literary achievement.
Public discussion of him is entangled with politics; that is not evidence of literary merit, and I have tried not to count it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic novels such as Carpentaria and The Swan Book remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. Her ambition, scale and mix of myth with political reality are distinctive and linguistically inventive. She offers an Indigenous Australian voice with a major formal presence in English-language fiction.
assessment.attribution: Single credited writer. A citation would cover epic, polyphonic fiction that integrates Waanyi and Aboriginal storytelling and ecological imagination into the English-language novel.
assessment.maturity: A strong body of work but a smaller number of major books than other candidates, so sustained development over decades is still being established.
uncertainties: The corpus is relatively compact, and the case for sustained, wide-ranging achievement is still forming.
I have not independently verified texts or her more recent works.
The relationship between the political and literary strands requires careful separation to avoid weighting symbolism over merit.
